title: Santa and the smallest reindeer.
lines: All the way at the top of the world, at the North Pole, it is always cold.
It snows almost every day there, and everything is white.
And there, in a cosy house with red shutters and a smoking chimney, lives Santa Claus.
Santa has a long white beard, a red suit with white trim, and a big tummy that shakes when he laughs.
Ho, ho, ho!
All year long Santa works with his helpers, the little elves.
In the big workshop they make toys for all the children in the world.
Dolls and trains, puzzles and balls, teddy bears and drawing sets.
Tap, tap, tap, go the little hammers.
And when everything is ready, the elves wrap the presents, with colourful paper and pretty bows.
Behind the house is the reindeer stable.
The reindeer pull Santa's sleigh.
They are big and strong, with brown fur and antlers on their heads.
And they can fly!
But the very smallest reindeer is called Little Star.
She's called that because she has a little white star on her head, between her eyes.
Little Star is still too small to pull the sleigh.
Every evening she watches the big reindeer practising flying.
Will I ever be able to do that too?
she asks Santa.
Santa strokes her little head.
One day, Little Star.
One day.
Then at last it's Christmas Eve.
The sleigh is completely full of presents.
Santa puts on his warm boots.
The big reindeer are ready.
Come on, off we go!
calls Santa.
And the sleigh flies up into the sky.
Jingle, jingle, go the bells.
But what Santa doesn't know: Little Star has secretly flown after the sleigh!
She wants to come along so badly.
In the middle of the night it suddenly starts to snow very hard.
A snowstorm is coming.
There is thick fog.
Santa can't see anything anymore.
No houses, no lights, nothing.
Oh no, says Santa.
How will I find the way now?
All the children are waiting for their presents!
And then he hears a little voice next to the sleigh.
Santa, I can help!
It's Little Star!
Little Star?
What are you doing here?
Little Star has very big, bright eyes.
And she can see very far in the dark, further than all the other reindeer.
Follow me!
she calls.
I can see the stars through the clouds, and I can see the lights of the houses!
Little Star flies in front, and the sleigh follows her.
Over the mountains, over the sea, over the forests and over the cities.
Over Antwerp too!
In every house Santa goes quietly inside, down the chimney.
He puts the presents under the Christmas tree, which is full of baubles and lights.
And what does he find on the table?
A glass of milk and a cookie for Santa.
And a carrot for the reindeer!
Mmm, thank you, children, whispers Santa.
Nibble, nibble, go the reindeer.
And Little Star gets the very biggest carrot.
And so they visit all the houses, one by one, until all the presents are gone.
When the sun comes up, they land back at the North Pole.
The elves cheer.
Hooray!
Santa lifts Little Star up.
Without you, little Little Star, we would have got lost.
You saved Christmas!
Ho, ho, ho!
And from that year on Little Star may fly at the front of the sleigh every year.
The smallest reindeer, with the biggest heart.
And in houses all over the world the children wake up, and they run to the Christmas tree.
Look!
Santa has been!
Merry Christmas!
